title: settings.json no longer wires the autopilot's PreCompact and SessionStart hooks or allows autopilot.py, so deleting autopilot.py cannot block compaction
goal: Removal only, nothing added: .claude/settings.json loses (1) the two allow rules Bash(python3 _tools/autopilot.py *) and PowerShell(python3 _tools/autopilot.py *), (2) the SessionStart entry with matcher compact that runs autopilot.py status --hook, (3) the PreCompact entry that runs autopilot.py precompact. Exactly four deletions, valid JSON, nothing reworded; the executor lists the diff in the report. test_settings_allow.py and any test that pins those lines follow. It lands BEFORE the file deletions of ST-dh5g3lk7, because a PreCompact hook that exits 2 blocks compaction for every session in the repository. Authority: the operator approved the retirement plan on 2026-10-04, and its R1 lists these settings removals; every other allow and deny rule stays.
